title: Product identity and beta-language review
verification_method: Review UI, README, installer, package metadata, changelog, and release output for canonical VaMender naming and explicit beta posture.

title: Supported Windows and VaM compatibility
verification_method: Build and run every official automated gate on Windows, verify no workflow uses Linux or macOS runners, install without elevation, and load the CLR 2 plugin in the verified VaM 1.22.0.13 runtime as a standard user. Record VaM 1.22.0.12 as expected but untested based on the documented plugin impact surface.

title: Read-only package inventory
verification_method: Run synthetic-corpus scenario 01 with check and check --deep on nested Unicode VARs and verify every package hash and path remains unchanged.

title: VaM-aware planning
verification_method: Run synthetic-corpus scenario 02 with fresh, stale, and absent VaM logs and verify runtime-confirmed language appears only with fresh matching evidence.

title: Metadata repair integration
verification_method: Run the metadata reconstruction and false-label Rust tests plus synthetic-corpus scenario 03, including missing, invalid, material-label, descriptive-label, explicit-license, and unknown-license behavior.

title: Filename and archive repair integration
verification_method: Run filename-repair scenarios 05 and 08 plus archive scenario 04; verify unambiguous renames, byte-identical duplicate archival, collision refusal, BZIP2 inspection, and diagnostic handling of unsupported LZMA, CRC-corrupt, and malformed archives.

title: Safe relink integration
verification_method: Run exact-reference fallback and synthetic-corpus scenarios 06 and 07; verify plugin references stay exact while safe non-plugin references relink and payload or metadata conflicts remain untouched.

title: Dependency-closure and missing-member diagnosis
verification_method: Run dependency-closure, missing-provider-member, and VaM missing-clothing warning Rust tests plus synthetic-corpus scenario 07.

title: Conservative migration integration
verification_method: Run migration rewrite/archive and metadata payload-conflict Rust tests plus synthetic-corpus scenario 06; confirm unsafe candidates remain installed.

title: Verified whole-VAR backup
verification_method: Run applied repair/migration corpus scenarios 03, 05, 06, 07, and 08 and verify source checksum, backup checksum, and manifest record precede every live mutation.

title: Atomic rewrite and post-validation
verification_method: Run applied rewrite corpus scenarios 03, 05, 06, and 08 and verify only a validated temporary archive reaches the destination and post-change checks pass.

title: Checksum and containment restore
verification_method: Exercise corpus scenario 08 normal, recent-subset, overwrite-conflict, checksum-failure, and traversal-rejection restore paths on a disposable root.

title: Predictable report handoff
verification_method: Run the complete synthetic corpus and verify the three top-level report files plus full-run _details evidence and deterministic unresolved IDs for every applicable scenario.

title: CLI mutation gate behavior
verification_method: Verify help safety text, corpus read-only immutability, dry-run defaults, and scenario 08 rejection of applied operations without a safe backup root.

title: Bridge allowlist and request validation
verification_method: Run bridge ID tests and one-cycle allowlist, root binding, lock, heartbeat, atomic state, and unknown-operation checks.

title: Plugin sandbox and live workflow
verification_method: Pass C# compile/type-load/security validation, including momentary action release, operation locking, and duplicate-status log suppression. Then exercise a lifecycle transition, successful engine operation, rescan, and visible status behavior in VaM 1.22.0.13. Record the 1.22.0.12 expectation separately; do not claim it was tested.

title: Installer and uninstall lifecycle
verification_method: Pass host-install Rust tests, Setup build, tools/run-isolated-vam-regression.ps1, and tools/run-isolated-installer-regression.ps1 against a marker-protected temporary VaM copy with redirected LOCALAPPDATA. Verify GUI-host startup registration, plugin checksum, revision-1 preservation/revision-2 retirement, bridge check, cooperative stop, real Setup uninstall, retained backup evidence, and restoration of the real user's startup registration.

title: Rights, privacy, and no-acquisition review
verification_method: Review the release diff and representative execution for content acquisition, authentication bypass, license guessing, telemetry, or restricted plugin APIs.

title: Package compatibility matrix
verification_method: Exercise synthetic-corpus scenarios 01 and 04 for Unicode, nesting, casing, BZIP2 support, unsupported-LZMA diagnosis, CRC corruption, and malformed archives without evidence loss.

title: Complete CI and CodeQL gate
verification_method: Require green pinned Specsmith audit, format, SPDX, Clippy, Rust tests, C# validation, VAR package, build/branding/Setup, artifact upload, and CodeQL jobs, all on GitHub-hosted Windows runners; require the reviewed github/codeql-action v4.37.6 init/analyze pins and reject any Linux or macOS runner declaration.

title: Tagged GitHub Actions beta release
verification_method: Push an approved matching v0.MINOR.PATCH tag and verify Windows-only Actions rejects any baseline DLL or normalized plugin-source hash mismatch, applies only the approved equal-length release stamp, validates the stamped CLR 2 metadata, packages the current integer VAR revision, checksums and retains all artifacts, and creates a GitHub prerelease with every expected asset from that commit.

title: Disposable-library beta acceptance
verification_method: Run tools/new-isolated-vam-test-environment.ps1 followed by tools/run-isolated-vam-regression.ps1 and tools/run-isolated-installer-regression.ps1 on Windows. Retain the synthetic-corpus and installer JSON summaries, reports, screenshots, backup manifests, mutation, restore, privacy-safe support bundle, versioned-plugin upgrade, real Setup uninstall, and host lifecycle evidence. Then record supported-environment VaM Session Plugin rescan, status-polling review, and report review on that disposable representative library.

title: Documentation consistency review
verification_method: Review all user and maintainer documents for naming, beta status, platform, backup warning, rights boundary, limitations, restore guidance, and independent-project disclosure.

title: Privacy-safe support bundle
verification_method: Run support-report fixtures and verify extracted package issues, optional inventory behavior, ZIP output, absence of absolute paths and raw logs, no network transmission, and mandatory review confirmation before GitHub handoff.

title: GitHub release and F95Zone announcement review
verification_method: Verify GitHub Actions built the tagged executable and published the exact tagged Setup, Session Plugin VAR, portable ZIP, and SHA-256 sidecars. Immediately before publishing, manually review current F95Zone rules and then verify the announcement links to the matching GitHub release without hosting a separate binary or disguising a download as support. Confirm it states beta status, Windows/external-engine requirement, explicit mutation and verified backup, tested VaM 1.22.0.13 / expected-but-untested 1.22.0.12 compatibility, project independence, and a genuine path-redacted UI capture. Confirm no VaM Hub submission or re-submission is requested because the project modifies VARs in AddonPackages.

title: v1.0.0 promotion gate review
verification_method: Require every v1.0.0 gate in docs/ROADMAP.md to have dated evidence, no unresolved release blocker, and explicit maintainer approval before changing the beta channel or publishing a v1.0.0 tag.

title: Pseudonymous maintainer history gate
verification_method: Run tools/check-maintainer-identity.ps1 across complete branch history and the annotated release tag, verify a synthetic non-TheAgenticCreator author or committer is rejected, verify pull-request CI selects the real head SHA instead of GitHub's temporary merge commit, and confirm the public repository event actor is TheAgenticCreatorDev or an approved organization GitHub App before publication.

title: Windows tray-host lifecycle
verification_method: Run tools/run-isolated-vam-regression.ps1 to verify GUI PE subsystem, direct startup registration, bridge availability, cooperative idle shutdown, lock cleanup, and restored user registration. On the same isolated VaM copy, manually verify the notification-area icon/menu, no console at sign-in or Start-menu launch, stable deduplicated in-VaM status polling, bridge availability while VaM opens and closes, active-work shutdown refusal, and one healthy no-argument restart.

title: Windows repository hygiene policy
verification_method: On Windows, verify tracked files exclude local VaM runtime state, credentials, assistant memory, and build products; verify .gitignore excludes representative local paths; and verify .gitattributes checks out project text as CRLF while preserving Git hooks as LF and release payloads as binary.
